items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1969-03-24
items.q: So you got Nelson, George, Papa John Joseph, Robichaud piano, I was on drums, and Punch. And we all agreed to go.

ctx.x: That was 1963, up in office, I believe. I told him, yeah. I said, who with? He said, well, Joe Band, George. I said, well, all right. Well, Jim didn't want to go. So you got Nelson, George, Papa John Joseph, Robichaud piano, I was on drums, and Punch. And we all agreed to go. He said, there was a three-month tour. I said, yeah, I don't mind it. Well, we went over there, and we really made a smashing hit with the people. They really went for jazz, like hook, line, and sinker. They loved it. And we stayed over…
That was the last tour you went on?

items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1971-04-08
items.q: I never heard the band with Alfred on drums and Joe Watkins

ctx.x: He wasn't much like that I'm telling you he wasn't much
Only on record you see I never heard the band with Alfred on drums and Joe Watkins
Now you know who was a rough fella and had a nice band maybe you didn't hear him? Chris Kelly Never heard him no
